g.text: Each row is a specification. Curves: posterior mean of the density of g with a pointwise 90%
posterior interval, all on one vertical scale. Points: posterior means of the mean and the standard
deviation of g and of the effects of the sites. Lines: 90% posterior intervals of those effects.
